newsitem.title: UK: Kawasaki joins Rolls Trent 900 programme.
newsitem.headline: Kawasaki joins Rolls Trent 900 programme.

text.p: British engineering group Rolls-Royce Plc said on Tuesday that Japan's Kawasaki Heavy Industries Ltd had agreed to become the first risk and revenue sharing partner on its Trent 900 engine programme.
Under the memorandum of understanding, Kawasaki Heavy will also increase its share in Rolls-Royce's Trent 800 programme to four percent, the company said in a statement.
Rolls-Royce said Kawasaki would take a six percent share in the Trent 900 programme.

The companies were also in talks about increasing Kawasaki's participation in the Trent 900, an 80,000-pound thrust class engine designed to power the latest large capacity four-engined airliners -- Boeing Co's 747-500X/600X and Airbus Industrie's A3XX.
Rolls-Royce said it was continuing to discuss partnerships in the Trent 900 with a number of aerospace companies.
The cost of the programme was not disclosed, and a company spokesman was not immediately available for comment.
Kawasaki would take its share through design work and manufacture in the turbine section.
The new agreement made Kawasaki the largest Trent risk and revenue sharing partner, Rolls-Royce said.
Kawasaki was already a significant partner in the RB211-524, Trent 700 and Trent 800 programmes.
